title: Groundnut — Pest Management and IPM
content:
MAJOR PESTS OF GROUNDNUT:

1. APHID (Aphis craccivora):
Symptoms: Curling of leaves, sticky honeydew, sooty mold.
Management: Imidacloprid 17.8 SL @ 150 ml/ha or Dimethoate 30 EC @ 660 ml/ha. NSKE 5% as first spray.

2. THRIPS (Caliothrips indicus):
Symptoms: Silver streaks on leaves, vector of bud necrosis virus.
Management: Spinosad 45 SC @ 160 ml/ha or Fipronil 5 SC @ 1000 ml/ha.

3. LEAF EATING CATERPILLAR (Spodoptera litura):
Symptoms: Skeletonization of leaves, gregarious feeding at night.
Management: Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC @ 150 ml/ha or Emamectin benzoate 5 SG @ 200 g/ha.
Biological: NPV of Spodoptera @ 250 LE/ha.

4. WHITE GRUB (Holotrichia spp.):
Symptoms: Wilting of plants in patches, roots eaten.
Management: Chlorpyriphos 20 EC @ 3 L/ha soil drench at sowing. Phorate 10G @ 12 kg/ha in furrow.

5. APHID-BORNE BUDO NECROSIS:
Prevention: Control aphids and thrips (vectors) early.

IPM APPROACH:
- Monitor field twice weekly.
- Use sticky yellow traps for aphids and thrips @ 10/ha.
- Conserve natural enemies (lady beetles, lacewings).
- Avoid broad-spectrum sprays in early crop stages.
- Chemical spray only when economic threshold is reached.
